title: WS send_request tests are false oracles: don't exercise WsRequestFrame
description: ws/mod.rs tests send_request_includes_at_type_request, send_request_includes_id_when_provided, send_request_omits_id_when_none (lines 322-398) manually reconstruct the old JSON-mutation approach (serde_json::to_value + obj.insert) rather than serializing WsRequestFrame. If WsRequestFrame serde had a bug (e.g. @type key wrong, flatten clash), all three tests would still pass. Violates test oracle principle: tests must verify the actual code path, not a manually-reconstructed equivalent.
